submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Carefully repaint Image 1 into one opaque native 1254x1254 game-map detail square at exactly the same framing, camera, scale and coordinates. The entire subject is ivory paving with broad softly curved joint routes and a cropped green tree canopy entering from the bottom left. Retain every paving joint route and endpoint, curve width and tree silhouette. The leftmost 230 pixels are true already-generated neighbor pixels: preserve them exactly, continuously extend their fine green leaves and their stone seams, color and shading into the remaining image. There must be no visual discontinuity or straight line at the pasted guide strip boundary. Reconstruct the soft interior into clear delicate hand-painted detail: subtle clean stone faces and fine rounded bevels, small green leaf organization inside the existing canopy without expanding its footprint. Do not move, enlarge, recrop, rotate, replace or add anything. NO planter, railings, lanterns, flowers, medallions, symbols, buildings, people, extra tree, text, UI, border or watermark. Image 2 is ONLY the user-approved primary style reference for bright clean rounded Daoist chibi painting and warm restrained material shading; copy none of its objects or decoration. Keep quiet ivory pavement, green leaves, soft daylight and clear contours; no gritty cracks, noise, excessive marbling, plastic shine, blur or sharpening halos. Return only the same full-bleed detail square, highest available fidelity.
